title.zh: 月之暗面（Kimi）IPO前谈和解，旧案索赔或超7亿美元
title.en: 月之暗面（Kimi）IPO前谈和解，旧案索赔或超7亿美元

current_state.zh: Moonshot AI (Kimi) is negotiating a settlement with former company Recurrent.ai and its investors over a nearly two-year arbitration dispute that could be worth over $700M, as it seeks to clear the way for its Hong Kong IPO filing.
